comprehension.summary: This PR refactors the ordinal "normal function" API by deprecating `Ordinal.IsNormal` (and related lemmas) in favor of the more general `Order.IsNormal`, updating downstream ordinal/cardinal files accordingly while adding a few bridging lemmas and aliases.

candidates.claim: In `Ordinal.iSup_pow_natCast`, the proof term `apply_omega0_of_isNormal` is referenced, but in this file the established API is `(isNormal_opow ho₁).apply_omega0`. As written in the reviewed region excerpt, this name does not appear to exist (it is not in scope in `Mathlib/SetTheory/Ordinal/Exponential.lean`), so readers will not be able to follow or reuse this proof step (and in an isolated check this identifier is unknown).

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem iSup_pow_natCast {o : Ordinal} (ho : 0 < o) : ⨆ n : ℕ, o ^ n = o ^ ω := by
  simp_rw [← opow_natCast]
  rcases (one_le_iff_pos.2 ho).lt_or_eq with ho₁ | rfl
  · exact (isNormal_opow ho₁).apply_omega0
  · rw [one_opow]
    refine le_antisymm (Ordinal.iSup_le fun n => by rw [one_opow]) ?_
    exact_mod_cast Ordinal.le_iSup _ 0

candidates.requested_change: Replace the proof line `· exact apply_omega0_of_isNormal (isNormal_opow ho₁)` by `· exact (isNormal_opow ho₁).apply_omega0` in `Ordinal.iSup_pow_natCast`.

candidates.claim: In `Ordinal.isNormal_veblenWith_zero`, the proof starts with `rw [isNormal_iff]`, but for `IsNormal` on ordinals the available lemma is `isNormal_iff_strictMono_limit` (as used previously); rewriting with `isNormal_iff` fails to elaborate, breaking the file.
candidates.concern_label: proof uses wrong lemma name after IsNormal refactor

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem isNormal_veblenWith_zero (hp : 0 < f 0) : IsNormal (veblenWith f · 0) := by
  rw [isNormal_iff_strictMono_limit]
  refine ⟨veblenWith_zero_strictMono hf hp, fun o ho a IH ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [veblenWith_of_ne_zero f ho.ne_bot, derivFamily_zero]
  apply nfpFamily_le fun l ↦ ?_
  suffices ∃ b < o, List.foldr _ 0 l ≤ veblenWith f b 0 by
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := this
    exact hb'.trans (IH b hb)
  induction l with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa using ho.bot_lt
      · simp
  | cons a l IH =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := IH
      refine ⟨_, ho.succ_lt (max_lt a.2 hb), ((veblenWith_right_strictMono hf _).monotone <|
        hb'.trans <| veblenWith_left_monotone hf _ <|
          (le_max_right a.1 b).trans (le_succ _)).trans ?_⟩
      rw [veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf]
      rw [lt_succ_iff]
      exact le_max_left _ b
